_ConnectionStrings_note: SECRET — do not commit real values here. Override at run time from env vars (ConnectionStrings__Students etc.), a container secret file, or a secret store. Empty values below force the fail-fast in Program.cs if the override is missing — every database the host requires must be listed, or a missing override silently falls back to the relative dev path in appsettings.json and writes a stray database next to the binary.
_Proxy_note: Turn Enabled on ONLY when a trusted reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx/ingress) is the sole route to this app and its own port is not published. See ReverseProxy.cs — X-Forwarded-For is forgeable by anyone who can reach Kestrel directly. KnownNetworks is the proxy's network in CIDR form; the Docker default bridge range is 172.16.0.0/12.
